affinity.notes: Its construction is plainly physical stone; restrained runes do not imply a dominant affinity.

anatomy.notes: Block-built humanoid proportions and joints are immediately understandable.

archetype.notes: Tank or bruiser does not communicate the intended programmable sequence duty.

counterplay.notes: Huge fists, thick armor blocks, and lumbering proportions cue slow, heavy frontal attacks.

finish.notes: Stone wear and carved runes are cleanly resolved.

framing.notes: Full body is centered with ample separation from the ruins.

identity.notes: Rune-carved stone golem identifies the Rune Warrior form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T3; exact intended tier is T3.
